messages:
Iris M: Quick sync 48h before webinar. Need: final speaker blurbs, who owns emergency swap, and lead-routing escalation.

Ben C: Speaker blurbs updated in the doc. Ill be primary demo lead, Tara is backup if infra pulls me.

Tara Y: Confirm backup. Also uploaded a 30s recorded fallback clip (start 00:00:30) here: https://video.redwood/fallbacks/short_demo.mp4

Iris M: Nice. For escalation, propose DM to the oncall SDR instead of just posting to channel for hot leads. Threshold suggestion?

Nora P: Suggest threshold = 6 signups in any rolling 10min -> immediate DM to @oncall-sdr + create ticket in Zendesk. If 2-5 signups, post to #sales-digest and batch CSV every 15m.

Ben C: Agree. Add tagging: webinar_apr2026_hot for hot, webinar_apr2026_warm for warm. Feed into CRM ingest.

Tara Y: Emergency swap one-liner for ops (put in runbook):
```bash
# emergency swap to recorded clip
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/v1/stream/swap \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_KEY" \
  -d '{"mode":"recorded","url":"https://video.redwood/fallbacks/short_demo.mp4","reason":"latency_or_hallucination"}'
```

Iris M: Perfect. Also adding a short canned line for presenters if we hit hallucination: "We're switching to a safe demo while we investigate that response." Keep it short and move on.

NodeBot: [automated] health-check scheduled for 2026-05-20T17:10:00Z.

NodeBot: [automated] health-check passed: GPU 46%, CPU 58%, avg latency 170ms, kv-cache hit 82%.

Nora P: I'll wire the DM action and Zendesk webhook tonight: https://hooks.zapier.com/hooks/catch/zzzz/yyy. Will post mapping to the runbook when done.

Ben C: Rehearsal plan: presenters join 20m early, mic/echo test, slide sync, run long-tail prompt run. Preflight 09:50 PT in #marketing.

Tara Y: I'll publish the one-pager for speakers with timecodes and who mutes/unmutes.

Iris M: Thanks team. Final ask  everyone confirm availability for preflight.

Ben C: Confirmed.

Tara Y: Confirmed.

Nora P: Confirmed."
